title: cleanup_orphan_msg: .ends_with('.msg') matches .msg.tmp
description: cleanup_orphan_msg_files (relay_queue.rs:252) filters with path.to_str().is_some_and(|s| s.ends_with(".msg")), which also matches .msg.tmp files. The comment on the line explicitly says 'not .msg.tmp' but the predicate does not enforce it. A .msg.tmp file has no .env partner, so it would be treated as an orphan and moved to dead/ on any run where cleanup_tmp_files did not already delete it (e.g. if cleanup_tmp_files fails early or a .msg.tmp is created concurrently). The drain_once loop at line 322 uses path.extension().is_some_and(|e| e == "env") which correctly uses the OS extension semantics. cleanup_orphan_msg_files should use path.extension().is_some_and(|e| e == "msg") for correctness and consistency.
